 ---- Applicant
 Versus
  State Of Chhattisgarh Through The Police Station Ramanujganj, District
 Balrampur-Ramanujganj (C.G.)

---- Respondent
For Applicant : Shri Hariom Rai, Advocate For State : Shri G.P.Kurrey, Panel Lawyer Hon'ble Shri
Justice Sachin Singh Rajput Order On Board 20/02/2023
1.

The applicant has been arrested in connection with Crime No.304/2022 registered at Police Station - Ramanujganj, District - Balrampur - Ramanujganj (C.G.) for alleged commission of offences under Section 376 (2) (n) of IPC and Section 4, 6 of POCSO Act.
2. Prosecution case, in brief, is that the applicant abducted the prosecutrix, who is a minor and committed sexual intercourse with her.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated.
He has not committed any crime.
It is submitted that the prosecutrix has been examined and she has not supported the case of the prosecution.
The applicant is in jail since 21/08/2022 and trial is likely to take some time.
Therefore, the applicant may be granted bail.
4. On the other hand, learned State counsel opposes the bail application and submits that looking to the allegations leveled, the application may be rejected.
5. The prosecutrix and her mother appeared through V.C. from the concerned DLSA and raised no objection to grant of bail to the applicant.
6. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

7. sentences.text: commenting anything on merits, I am inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
8. Accordingly, the application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- along with one surety for the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court on the condition that - a) He shall appear before the trial Court regularly on each and every date, unless exempted from appearance.
b) He shall not make any attempt to tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
Certified copy as per rules.
